a stock llama-server started by lethe (per-launch api key via `lethe key`, 127.0.0.1 only). `model` is a label in the log; the server serves whatever `lethe serve [spec]` loaded. No repo access, so address it on prose/design proposals, not diffs. Thinking is off both ways: --no-thinking at serve and enable_thinking false per request, because the records grammar leaves no room for a think block.
the appender's voice: timeouts, rejected turns, rebase conflicts and summaries are `say` records from dispatch
